name: esp32_c3_oled_042
title: ESP32-C3 with a 0.42-inch OLED
description: A small ESP32-C3 board with a 72x40 SSD1306 OLED on I2C: 4 MB flash in the chip, USB-C to the chip, a power LED, a blue LED, BOOT and RST buttons, a ceramic antenna
notes: Sold by many shops with no maker on the board. The schematic read is that of the ABrobot board; Anton's board agrees with it on every pin tried.
The OLED shows a 72x40 window of the 128x64 memory of its SSD1306, from segment 28, as the specification of the panel N042-7240TSWEG01-H16 gives it.

oled.notes: BS1 is high and D/C low, so I2C at 0x3C. SCL and SDA have 4.7 kΩ to VCC (R4, R7). RES is held low at power-on by R2 and C12, not by a GPIO.

led.notes: Blue, from VCC through R8: it lights while GPIO 8 is low. GPIO 8 is a strapping pin, held high by R1.

boot.notes: BOO on the board; R6 holds GPIO 9 high.

usb.notes: The USB-C goes to the USB Serial/JTAG of the chip, the console and the flashing. CC1 and CC2 have 5.1 kΩ to GND (R13, R14).

d_usb.notes: From VUSB to VCC5V; the schematic names a 1N5819HW.

reg_3v3.notes: An LDO from VCC5V to VCC.

power.name: VUSB
power.why: VBUS of the USB-C, also contact 1 of JP2 (V5 on the board).

power.name: VCC
power.why: Contact 3 of JP2 (V3 on the board).

front.source: a photo by Anton of his board, 2026-11-06

back.source: a photo by Anton of his board, 2026-11-06

pins.source: the schematic ESP32C3 OLED原理图.pdf in Document/ of github.com/zhuhai-esp/ESP32-C3-ABrobot-OLED, fetched 2026-11-06

panel.source: SPEC N042-7240TSWEG01-H16 VER A of Newvision, in the same Document/: an SSD1306, 72x40, an active area of 9.196 x 5.18 mm, segments 28 to 99 and COM 0 to 39

bench.by: Anton, by eye, and the logs
bench.notes: An I2C scan of every pair of GPIO 0 to 10 at 0x3C and 0x3D found one device, 0x3C on SDA 5 and SCL 6. DGX 0.10.11 with SSD1306_72X40 drew a frame on the edge of the window with both diagonals, all seen. The blue LED is on while GPIO 8 is low.

chip.source: esptool on Anton's board: ESP32-C3 (QFN32) rev 0.4, 4 MB flash in the chip (XMC)
